tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa blo gsal nyer mkho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ gang zhig bsten na mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub ma lus myur du stsol mdzad pa'i// phongs pa kun skyob rje btsun sgrol ma la// nye bar btud nas de yi rjes gnang bri// 'dir grub pa'i slob dpon chen po nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs mtho bar rten khebs kyis bkab pa'i steng*/ dbus su mañdzi'i khar maṇḍal dri bzang gi thig le byugs pa'i steng du 'bras kyi tshom bu/ de'i mdun du dkar gtor rgyan ldan/ de dag gi mdun du phreng tshar gyis chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ nang mchod/ me tog gi snod/ slob ma la bkye bsdu'i chas maṇḍal me tog dang bcas pa sta gon bya/ rjes gnang sprel nas byed na du byed kyi grangs kyi tshom bu/ zhal zas/ gtor ma kha gso ba'i mtheb kyu yang bsham/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thog mar seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo dkrol/

bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes bdun sogs brjod/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun ma sgrol ma bsgom par bgyi/ lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rje btsun sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig dang bcas pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ oṃ āryā tā rā sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ oṃ āryā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig ljang gu yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma seng lding nags kyi sgrol ma sku mdog ma rgad ltar ljang ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon utpa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung zhing 'dab ma snyan gyi thad sor kha bye ba/ dbu skra phyed du li ba ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang pa'i rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni sogs nas shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs pa gtad de/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes brjod/ de nas tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma zhes pa nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar gong bdag bskyed ltar las rang nyid ces pa dor/ de nas mchod pa kha gso/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs dharmā ra ṇi dor ba gong ltar/ oṃ āryā tā rā arghaṃ shabda'i bar mtshan sngags sbyar bas phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ lha dang lha min sogs shlo ka gcig gis bstod/ gtor ma la chus bran/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥzhes pas byin gyis brlab/ yi ge bcu pa'am mtshan sngags oṃ āryā tā rā sa pa ri wa ra zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis dbul/ gong ltar mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zhig bya/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang snyam pa bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal zhes sogs chos bshad rgyas bsdus gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar 'tsham par bshad nas/ da lam 'dir gsan bya chos kyi ngo bo ni rgyud sde bzhi'i nang nas rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa dang rjes su mthun par bkral ba rje btsun ma sgrol ma yin zhing*/ de la'ang lugs srol mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa las/ 'dir skabs su bab pa dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po nyi ma sbas pa'i zhal snga nas legs par bkral ba'i sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la thog mar seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes su gnang ba yin/ de la'ang slob dpon dang slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyis bgyid 'os thams cad legs par grub nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa/ thog mar slob dpon la seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇḍal phul nas phyag me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun ma nyer gcig gi lha tshogs mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la rje btsun ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

lan gsum/ zhes pa rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed la phog gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la phog pas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyis de nyid la dmigs te oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ zhes brjod pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du sangs kyis sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams skad cig gis rje btsun ma zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs po ta la nas rje btsun ma'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ bar pa mi tshad tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa mtsho chen po la char babs pa'am/ rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa ltar sib sib gnyis su med par thim nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la rol mo dang gu gul gyis bdug cing*/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar ā we sha ya aḥ.aḥ zhes yang yang brjod/ des rje btsun ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byas nas rje btsun ma'i sku dang nus pa mnyam par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su tām̐ yig gi mthar yi ge bcu pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/

slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces yi ge bcu pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ de ltar byas pas dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan pa'i mos pa byas nas slob dpon la drin lan du me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis kyang khyed rang rnams kyis phul ba'i me tog de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas dbu gtsug tu gtor nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// bcom ldan 'das ma'i byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig des rje btsun ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byas nas rje btsun ma'i gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed la phog gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis lho phyogs po ta la na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i thugs brgyud bskul bas de'i thugs ka nas rje btsun ma'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo utpal ljang khu bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon te khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sib sib thim pas thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa thugs rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la sngar ltar dril gsil dang sngags brjod/

des rje btsun ma'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba legs par thob/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byas nas rje btsun ma'i thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rjes gnang sbrel nas byed na/ des dang po seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa yin zhes brjod nas/ de bar la phyi ma'i lung bklag mchod g.yog pas mchod pa kha gso/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan gcig brjod/ badzra muḥtshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod nas/ slar yang mchod gtor kha gso/ tshom bu gsar pa dgod/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong ltar bya/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan re brjod/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes sogs so so'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa cung zad dang bcas pa bya/ tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ bdag bskyed yan lag bzhi rdzogs bya/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro nyer spyod dang*/ nang mchod/ phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo// zhes sogs shlo ka gcig gis bstod/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de bar la slob ma rnams kyis phyag 'tshal nyer gcig 'don/ de nas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya zhes sogs sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ gsan bya chos kyi ngo bo ni/ 'dir grub pa'i slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i zhal snga nas kyis sgrol ma nyer gcig bla med du bkral ba'i nang nas dang po sgrol ma myur zhing dpa' ba'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/

zhes dbul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la sgrol ma myur zhing dpa' ba'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gong du rgyas par bstan pa ltar 'og ma thams cad la rgya 'bag gi mig ltar 'khrul shes par bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ mjug tu/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi legs par grub nas/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag tu maṇḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ des slob dpon chen po nyi ma sbas pa'i zhabs kyis nye bar bkral ba'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig las 'di zhes bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba legs par gsan pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs thams cad la rigs 'gre shes par byas la bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// de ltar spyi 'gro'i chings rnams la go ba legs par chags par byas nas/ de nas so so'i mngon rtogs bstan pas shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang po sgrol ma myur zhing dpa' ba'i mngon rtogs ni/ ༈ /chos 'byung gi dbus su padma ser po dang zla ba'i gdan la oṃ las sgrol ma rab tu dpa' mo sku mdog dmar mo me phung 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis spyi bor bsnol ba'i rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa gnyis na mda' dang gzhu/ gsum pa gnyis na 'khor lo dang dung*/ bzhi pa gnyis na ral gri dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhi ba'i nyams can/ rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*// bstod pa ni/ phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo// spyan ni skad cig glog dang 'dra ma// 'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes zhal gyi// ge sar bye ba las ni byung ma// zhes pas bstod/

spro na rnam dag gtsug nor ma'i bstod pa yang so sor bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa dkar mo zla mdangs kyi sgrol ma ni/ pad zla la tā las rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo dkar sngo ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ dang po gnyis mnyam gzhag g.yas lhag mas kha ṭwāṃ ga 'khor lo/ nor bu/ rdo rje/ me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon rnams kyis spyi blugs/ utpal/ dril bu/ bum pa/ pusti 'dzin pa/ zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun tu// gang ba brgya ni brtsegs pa'i zhal ma// skar ma stong phrag tshogs pa rnams kyis// rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma// zhes so// ༈ /gsum pa gser mdog can ma'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la re las sgrol ma gser mdog can ma zhal gcig phyag bcu ma/ g.yas pa rnams kyis phreng ba/ ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ dbyu gu/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dar dpyangs/ zhags pa/ padma/ dril bu/ gzhu bsnams pa/ rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rin 'byung*/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal gser sngo chu nas skyes kyi// padmas phyag ni rnam par brgyan ma// sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub zhi ba// bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul nyi ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bzhi ba gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrol ma ni/ padma ser po dang zla ba la tu ta las sgrol ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang phreng ba/ g.yon spyi blugs dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ rigs bdag don grub/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor// mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma// mu lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i// rgyal ba'i sras kyis shin tu bsten ma// zhes so/ ༈ /lnga pa hūm̐ sgra sgrog pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dang zla ba la tāṃ las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon padma ser po bsnams pa/

zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal tuttā re hūm̐ yi ges// 'dod dang phyogs dang nam mkha' gang ma// 'jig rten bdun po zhabs kyis mnan te// lus pa med par 'gugs bar nus ma// zhes so/ ༈ /drug pa 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la re las sgrol ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje/ gnyis pas ral gri/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas zhags pa bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshangs pa// rlung lha sna tshogs dbang phyug mchod ma// 'byung po ro langs dri za rnams dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mdun nas bstod ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bdun pa rgol ba 'joms pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma ser po dang nyi ma'i gdan la tu las sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo na bza' ser po bsnams pa/ drag mo dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang pos 'khor lo/ gnyis pas ral gri/ g.yon dang pos padma la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ gnyis pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rin 'byung*/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal trata ces bya dang phaṭa kyis// pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis mnan te// me 'bar 'khrugs pa shin tu 'bar ma// zhes so/ ༈ /brgyad pa dbang mchog ster ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang zla ba dang chu srin rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la re las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga dang padma/ 'og ma gnyis nor bu dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin dang bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung phyed pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal tu re 'jigs pa chen mo// bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms ma// chu skyes zhal ni khro gnyer ldan mdzad// dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod ma// zhes so/

༈ /dgu pa bstod pa'i go rim la seng ldeng nags sgrol bshad kyang gong du bshad zin nas/ dkyus ltar mchog stsol sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang zla ba'i gdan la swā las sgrol ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dga' ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor 'ching ba/ g.yas 'og ma gar gyi tshul gyis se gol gtogs pa/ g.yon 'og mas mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pas 'gro ba rnams la rin po che'i char 'bebs pa/ zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i// ser mos thugs kar rnam par brgyan ma// ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor los brgyan pa'i// rang gi 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrugs ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bcu pa mya ngan sel ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang zla ba las sgrol ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ 'og ma gnyis ral gri dang a sho ka'i yal ga me tog dmar po can 'dzin pa/ rigs bdag don grub/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' ba brjid pa'i// dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreng ba spel ma// bzhad pa rab bzhad tuttā re yis// bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bcu gcig pa phongs pa sel ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hā las sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo drag mo'i sku can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gza' brgyad 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon phongs pa sel ba'i lcags kyu zhags pa dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rin 'byung*/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal sa gzhi skyong ba'i tshogs rnams// thams cad 'gugs par nus pa nyid ma// khro gnyer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūm̐ gis// phongs pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bcu gnyis pa bkra shis snang ba'i sgrol ma ni/ sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i steng du a las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams na rtse gsum/

lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon pa rnams na thugs kar gtod pa'i rin po che/ lcags kyu/ dbyu gu/ bum pa 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang*/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal zla ba'i dum bus dbur brgyan// brgyan pa thams cad shin tu 'bar ma// ral pa'i khrod nas 'od dpag med las// rtag par shin tu 'od rab mdzad ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bcu gsum pa yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la bhrūṃ las sgrol ma dmar mo drag mo'i sku can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos ral gri/ gnyis pas mda'/ g.yon gyi dang pos 'khor lo/ gnyis pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar// 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i dbus na gnas ma// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dga'i// dgra yi dpung ni rnam par 'joms ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bcu bzhi pa khro gnyer g.yo ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar ser dang nyi ma la mi ro'i steng du hūm̐ las sgrol ma khro gnyer can sku mdog mthing nag nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro gnyer bsdus pa mi'i rgyu ma zhal du gsol ba/ phyag drug g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis

dpe 'di'i dkyus su hūm̐ zhes yod/ yig rnying du phaṭa ces byung*/ sgrub rin las ata ces snang ba yi ge ma dag pa yin nam snyam/ thod pa/ zhags pa/ tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ stag spags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du rin po che'i shing myu gu skyes pa/ zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal sa gzhi'i ngos la phyag gi /mthil gyis bsnun cing zhabs kyis brdung ma// khro gnyer can mdzad yi ge hūm̐ gis// rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bco lnga pa dge legs ster ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dkar po dang zla ba la ṇi las sgrol ma zhi ba chen po sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag drug gi g.yas gsum phreng ba/ mchog sbyin/ dbyug pa/ g.yon gsum padma/ ril ba/ spyi blugs/ padma'i steng na pusti 'dzin pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma// mya ngan 'das zhi spyod yul nyid ma// swā hā oṃ dang yang dag ldan mas// sdig pa chen po 'joms pa nyid ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bcu drug pa chags pa 'joms pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar ser dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas thugs kar rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub 'phyar bas snying po dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i shing 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i// dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma// yi ge bcu pa'i ngag ni bkod pa'i// rig pa hūm̐ las sgrol ma nyid ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bcu bdun pa bde ba sgrub pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dkar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las sgrol ma sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa/

sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal tu re'i zhabs ni brdabs pas// hūm̐ gi rnam pa'i sa bon nyid ma// ri rab mandā ra dang 'bigs byed// 'jig rten gsum po g.yo ba nyid ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bco brgyad pa rab tu rgyas pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dkar po dang zla ba'i steng du ki las sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis spyi bor thal mo bsnol nas sbyar bas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis mchog sbyin dang*/ utpal gyi steng na pusti bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i// ri dwags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma// tā re gnyis brjod phaṭa kyi yi ges// dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma// zhes so/ ༈ /bcu dgu pa sdug bsngal sreg pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dkar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la dza las sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar me thab bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang pa'i sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang*/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po// lha dang mi'am ci yis bsten ma// kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis// rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ma// zhes so/ ༈ /nyi shu pa dngos grub 'byung ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang zla ba'i steng du tsa las sgrol ma sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i// spyan gnyis po la 'od rab gsal ma// ha ra gnyis brjod tuttā ra yis// shin tu drag po'i rims nad sel ma// zhes so/ ༈ /nyer gcig pa yongs rdzogs byed pa'i sgrol ma ni/ ha las skyes pa'i khyu mchog glang dkar po'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la pha las sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo cung zad khro zhing spyan gsum rnam thar sgo gsum la gzigs ma/

phyag g.yas mdung rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon mu tig gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rigs bdag rin 'byung*/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal de nyid gsum rnams bkod pas// zhi ba'i mthu dang yang dag ldan ma// gdon dang ro langs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams// 'joms pa tu re rab mchog nyid ma// zhes bstod do// de ltar sgrol ma nyer gcig po thams cad la rjes gnang gi dus sngags yi ge bcu pa 'ba' zhig bya zhing*/ sa bon kyang thams cad tām̐ yig rkyang pas kyang rung la/ zhabs stabs mi gsal ba rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung ngo*// 'di bla med du bkral ba yin pas shin tu legs shing so so'i las tshogs sgrub pa'i sngags dang bya tshul sogs rgya gzhung du gsal lo// paṇa chen nyi ma sbas pa'i bzhed pa'i srol// phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas// gsal bar bkod 'dis lugs 'di'i bka' srol rnams// mi nyams mchog tu dar ba'i rgyur gyur cig /ces rje btsun ma nyer gcig bla med ltar bkral ba slob dpon chen po sūrya gupta'i bzhed pa ltar sgrub thabs rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa blo gsal nyer mkho zhes bya ba 'di yang 'di gnyis kyi bka' mi nub par bya ba'i phyir rgya gzhung dang*/ bstod pa rnam dag gtsug nor/ rje btsun chen po'i gsung rab rnams kyi dgongs don sor bzhag rang gi bla ma las ji ltar thos pa'i gsung rgyun rnams go bde bar shākya'i btsun pa kun dga' lhun grub kyis bgrang gzhi bcu phrag drug dang nyag ma drug tu slebs pa sgyur byed kyi lo khrums zla ba'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la dben gnas smon dga' rin chen bsam gtan gling gi rang gi bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shing mang bka' bcu kun dga' bsam 'grub kyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang lugs 'di'i bka' mi nub cing 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/

//shu bha mastu sarba dza ga tāṃ/ slar yang rgya bod kyi gzhung gi yi ge rnying pa la gtugs te cung zad dag par spel ba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgrol ma'i chos skor las spyi'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs dang sgrol ma la// gus pas btud nas klu sgrub las 'ongs pa'i// sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bsnyen dang sgrub ldan pa// de yi mngon rtogs gsal por bri bar bya// 'dir klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrol ma spyi'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni dpal ldan rdo rje gdan bzhi dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ yang dag par sbyor ba'i thig le dang*/ las sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten nas 'gro ba rnams kyi don du mdzad pa yin no// de la gnyis/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'o// dang po ni stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma sngon du 'gro ba can byas te/ rang skad cig gis sgrol mar bsams pa'i snying gar padma dang zla ba'i steng du tām̐ bsams pa las 'od kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su bla ma dang*/ sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ yang snying ga'i 'od zer las mchod pa'i tshogs spros shing*/ oṃ badzra puṣpe hūm̐ zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod pas mchod pa bya/ de nas sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ bsngo ba bla na med pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed pa/ lus dbul ba/ gnang ba nod pa ste bdun so sor bya ba'am/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes pa la sogs pa gur nas 'byung ba bzhin du gang rung gis byas nas/ tshad med pa rnam pa bzhi bsgoms te bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags nas/ shū n+ya tā la sogs pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ste stong pa nyid bsgom/ de'i ngang las byang chub kyi sems rjes su dran pa'i stobs kyis gzugs kyis skur langs la sems can kyi don bya'o zhes bsams nas/

paṃ las padma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ ljang gu las utpal tām̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus nas thim pa'i skad cig la bdag sgrol ma sku mdog ljang sngon/ phyag g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa ster ba'i skyabs sbyin/ g.yon pas utpal bzung ba'i 'dab mas rna bar reg pa/ skra cung zad li ba g.yas su cung zad 'phyang ba/ dar gyi na bzas bklubs shing rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ lang tsho dar la bab pa/ rab tu 'dzum pa'i skur bsams nas/ yan lag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ mig tu oṃ tā re swā hā dkar mo/ rna ba ru oṃ tuttā re swā hā sngon mo/ sna la oṃ tu re swā hā ser mo/ lce la oṃ tu swā hā dmar mo/ snying gar oṃ re swā hā sngon mo/ spyi bor oṃ tā re ṇi swā hā ljang gu bsam pa ste/ thams cad zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// de nas snying ga'i tām̐ las 'od 'phros pas po ta la nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la bstim/ dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs te/ gsol ba btab nas dbang bskur te don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ snying gar padma dang zla ba'i steng gi tām̐ la yi ge bcu pas bskor bar bsams nas yi ge bcu pa nyid bzla bar bya'o// de ltar thun grangs dang thun tshad ni ci rigs par bya la/ spyod lam thams cad ni lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan par bya'o// de lta bu'i grangs kyi bsnyen pa tha mas 'bum phrag gsum/ 'bring gis drug rab kyis bcu/ yang rab kyis bcu gnyis bzlas na 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs kyang thams cad kyis 'bum phrag bcu gsum bzlas na las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o// sgrub pa dang las la sbyar ba'i sngon du bsrung bar 'dod na/ lha'i rnal 'byor snga ma bzhin du bskyed pa'i snying gar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa lta ba dang mu khyud du bcas pa kha dog ljang gu bsams pa'i lte bar oṃ dang hā'i bar du che ge mo rakṣa rakṣa dang bcas pa spel mar bsams la/

rtsibs brgyad la tā re tuttā re tu re swā zhes bsam/ mu khyud la ā li g.yon skor/ kā li g.yas skor du bsams nas 'khor lo dang yi ge dang*/ de dag las 'od zer ljang sngon gyi rnam pa 'phros te bsgrub bya'i lus la bkang bas bsrung bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re che ge mo rakṣa rakṣa swā hā zhes bzlas na bsrung ba dang*/ 'chi ba bslu bar 'gyur ro// 'on kyang 'chi ba slu ba'i sgrol ma ni dkar mo yin no// gzhan btson ra las thar bar bya ba dang*/ nad la sogs pa zhi bar bya ba'i las rnams las sgrol ma dkar mo dang*/ 'khor lo dang yig 'bru dkar por bsams nas ji ltar 'dod pa'i sngags kyi spel tshig dang bcas pas spel te 'od zer 'phro ba la sogs pa cho ga lhag ma snga ma bzhin du byas na de dang de 'grub par 'gyur ro// dbang du bya ba ni rje btsun ma dmar mor bsgom pa dang*/ tsakra dang yi ge'i kha dog dang 'od zer yang dmar por bya zhing che ge mo ba shyaṃ ku ru ho'i sngags kyi spel tshig dang bcas pa bzlas te/ cho ga lhag ma ni snga ma bzhin byas na dbang dang 'gugs pa'i las 'grub par 'gyur ro// longs spyod rgyas pa la sogs pa'i las la rje btsun ma ser mo dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ yi ge'i kha dog dang*/ 'od zer yang ser por spro zhing puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ gyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa bzlas te/ cho ga lhag ma snga ma bzhin byas na longs spyod la sogs pa rgyas pa'i las 'grub par 'gyur ro// shes rab zhan pa dang*/ le lo can dang*/ dad pa chung ba rnams la ni rje btsun ma dkar mo dang*/ 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ dang hā'i bar du che ge mo shes rab 'phel bar mdzod cig ces pa bsams te/ cho ga lhag ma rnams ni snga ma ltar yin gyi 'on kyang gong ma'i 'khor lo'i yi ge rnams ni g.yas skor ā li g.yon skor kā li g.yas skor yin pa las 'dir 'khor lo la dgod pa'i yi ge thams cad ni g.yon skor du bkod nas 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang*/

las kyi spel tshig dang bcas pa'i sngags bzlas na shes rab 'phel ba la sogs pa'i las 'grub par 'gyur ro// 'di rnams 'khor lo snying gar bsgom pa'i las yin no// 'khor lo de rnams gro ga la sogs pa'i gzhi la gur gum la sogs pas ji lta ba bzhin bris te bsgrubs na yang gong gi las rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro// de rnams kyi don ni 'di yin te/ bsnyen pa sngon du song bas las la sbyor ba la/ sgrol ma dang 'khor lo dang yi ge'i kha dog so sor bsgyur ba dang*/ yi ge dgod pa g.yas skor dang g.yon skor gyi bye brag dang*/ bsgrub bya so so la dmigs pa dang*/ 'od zer kha dog so sor spro ba dang*/ ngag gi bzlas pa'i mthar rakṣa sogs kyi sngags kyi spel tshig bsgyur ba dang*/ 'khor lo'i dbus kyi spel tshig bsgyur ba ste drug gis shes par bya ba yin no// mdor na lha'i kha dog so so la sogs pas ji ltar 'dod pa'i las so so rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba kho na yin no// spyi'i sgrub thabs kyi brjed byang*// ༈ /so so'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti/ yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// spyi'i sgrub thabs bzhin bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs nas sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi dus kyi rnal 'byor/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi mngon par rtogs pa rnams kyi spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa ni 'di yin te/ tshogs bsag pa'i zhing mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas mchod pa dang*/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag ye shes kyi tshogs bsag stong nyid bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma la sogs pa'i so so'i gdan gyi steng du rang rang gi sa bon tsam las skad cig gis dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs dang*/ yan lag drug byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba dang*/ dbang bskur bas rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab ste/

rang rang gi sa bon las/ rang rang gi dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa'i sku mdog dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ zhal phyag gi grangs dang*/ gdan dang*/ bzhugs tshul gyi khyad par dang*/ zhi khro dang*/ sngags kyi khyad par rnams so so'i gzhung nas 'byung bas de rnams ma gtogs pa'i sngon du 'gro ba dang mjug gi cho ga rnams ni spyi'i sgrub thabs dang mthun pas/ 'dir tho yig tsam las ma bstan pa yin no// gzhung so so'i mi gsal ba rnams cung zad tsam brjod par bya ste/ dang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi sgrol ma oṃ ser po las paṃ zhes pa'i sgra 'byung ba'i skad cig mas bskyed par byas nas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa'o// gzhung las/ rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba ni/ rdo rje dril bu bsnol te thugs kar 'dzin pa'o// gnyis pa gsung gi rigs ni tā las bskyed nas zla ba'i steng du bzhugs pa ni 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa'o// drug pa na pusti bsnams zhes bya ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti'o// gsum pa rin po che'i rigs kyi sgrol ma ni re las bskyed par bya'o// bzhi pa las kyi rigs ni tuta las bskyed par bya'o// lnga pa gsung gi rigs ni tā las so// drug pa gsung gi rigs ni re las so// bdun pa rin po che'i rigs ni tu las so// skye gnas kyi steng na zhags pa bsnams pa zhes bya ba ni padma'o// brgyad pa las kyi rigs ni re las so// dgu pa las kyi rigs ni swā las so// phyag dang po gnyis spyi bor rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya bcings pa zhes bya ba ni spyi bor pad kor mdzad pa'o// bcu pa rin po che'i rigs ni hā las cung zad khro ba bskyed par bya'o// bcu gcig pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs ni a las so// bcu gnyis pa padma'i rigs ni bhrūm̐ las bskyed par bya'o// bcu gsum pa las kyi rigs ni a las so// phyogs dang mtshams myu gu 'dzin pa zhes bya ba ni/

phyogs mtshams brgyad du paṃ las ratna'i ljon shing bsam par bya'o// bcu bzhi pa gsung gi rigs ni tā las so// pusti bsnams pa zhes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti'o// bco lnga pa thugs kyi rigs ni a las so// g.yon pa snying po dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya zhes pa ni utpal bsnams pa'o// bcu drug pa las kyi rigs ni shaṃ las so// bcu bdun pa gsung gi rigs ni tām̐ las so// phyag dang po gnyis dga' ba'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa zhes pa ni/ phyag gnyis thugs kar 'khyud pa'i stangs so// spyi bor pad kor phyag rgya mdzad pa'o// bco brgyad pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs ni dzaṃ las so// bcu dgu pa las kyi rigs ni rtse las so// nyi shu pa rin po che'i rigs ni pheṃ las bskyed par bya'o// sku mdog la sogs pa ni so so'i gzhung nyid du gsal lo// dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po ni/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan pa yin no// so so'i sngags ni rang rang gi 'og nas/ rang rang gi las kyi tshogs nas 'byung bas der blta bar bya'o// gong gi cho ga rnams ni sngar nyid du brjod par bas so// sgrub thabs so so'i mngon par rtogs pa'i brjed byang*// ༈ /bstod pa 'don thabs kyi brjed byang bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti/ thun mtshams su phyag 'tshal nyer gcig pa gdon par 'dod pas/ thog mar sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal chen po nas bsgral la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la dgod par bya snyam du sems bskyed/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar padma'i sdong po chen po'i steng du/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa ratna'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'od dpag med kyi dbur brgyan cing*/ phyag g.yas pas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pas padma thugs kar 'dzin pa'i padma kha bye ba'i steng na rje btsun ma sgrol ma bdag la zhal gzigs shing bzhugs pa/

bdag bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dam tha mal pa'i nga rgyal gyis kyang btub ste/ yi ge bcu pa ci rigs pa zhig dang*/ gzungs sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig pa gcig brjod nas/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig ci 'grub gdon te/ gzhung nas 'byung ba'i che ba'i yon tan bsam zhing gdon par bya'o// de nas rje btsun ma la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ smon lam rnam par dag pa btab ste/ rten rnams bdag la thim pa'am mi dmigs par byas te ci bde bar gnas par bya'o// 'don pa'i thabs kyi lo rgyus ni 'di yin te/ rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bskal pa dpag tu med par sems can gyi don byas nas sems can dpag tu med pa grol bar byas pa dang*/ sems can ji tsam zhig gis nyung bar 'gyur zhes bltas pa na/ bri ba dang gang ba gang yang ma gzigs nas thugs mug pas spyan chab byung bas/ de las padma skyes/ padma kha bye ba'i nang nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma byung ste/ de'i zhal nas thugs mug par mi bya ste/ khyod kyis sems can gyi don byed pa'i grogs ni bdag gis bya ste/ sems can dpag tu med pa bsgral bar bya'o// zhes gsungs so// de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyis bstod pa ni phyag 'tshal sgrol ma zhes bya ba la sogs pa ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ gnyis pa rgyan dang 'od zer gyi sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ gsum pa sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ bzhi pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bsten par byas shing de rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ lnga pa 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ drug pa 'jig rten pa'i che ba rnams kyis mchod pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ bdun pa brgyad pa pha rol gyi byad bzlog pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/

dgu pa 'jig rten pa rnams bdag la mos par bya ba'i phyir dbang du mdzad pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ bcu pa thams cad 'gugs shing phongs pa thams cad sel ba'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa rgyan dang rigs kyi bdag po'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa drag po'i lha mos gdug pa can thams cad 'dul ba'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa sdig pa thams cad 'joms pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ bco lnga pa rtsa ba'i sngags kyi yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ bcu drug pa sa bon gyi yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ bcu bdun pa brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dug sel ba'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ bco brgyad pa thams cad kyis mchod cing rtsod pa dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ba'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ bcu dgu pa rgyan dang cha lugs dang*/ sngags kyis shin tu drag po'i rims nad sel ba'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ nyi shu pa gdon dang ro langs la sogs pa gdug pa can thams cad 'joms pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan thams cad rje btsun ma khyod nyid la ldan no zhes bstod pa'o// nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa rtsa ba'i sngags mngon du brjod cing bstod pa brjod pa'i gang zag la phan yon gyi tshogs rnams 'byung bar bstan to// bstod pa 'don pa'i thabs kyi brjed byang*// spyi'i sgrub thabs dang*/ so so'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rab tu gsal ba dang*/ nyi shu rtsa gcig 'don pa'i cho ga 'di// byas pa'i dge des 'gro rnams sangs rgyas shog /spyi dang so so'i mngon par rtogs pa dang*/ bstod pa 'don pa'i thabs kyi brjed byang*// dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis nye bar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /nyi sbas lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi zin bris skal bzang nyer mkho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ 'khor lo'i mgon po rje btsun mar// btud nas de yi sgrub pa'i thabs// nyi ma sbas pa'i zhal lung las// nyer mkho'i zin bris cung zad bri// 'di la gsum/

rjes su gnang ba dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ las sbyor gyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris so// dang po ni/ rmor chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga blo gsal nyer mkho las rtsa ba'i sgrol ma seng ldeng nags sgrol spyir btang ltar mdzad pa na gzhung de nyid du shes la/ yig rnying dang sgrub thabs rin 'byung sogs las sgrol ma spyi sgrub nyid rtsa bar bkod cing de'i rjes gnang yang bzhugs pas/ spyir sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi chings rnams blo gsal nyer mkho ltar la bdag mdun gyi mngon rtogs kho bos byas pa'i rnal 'byor nyer mkho ltar sbyar/ bum pa spyi ltar bcas la bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su padma dang zla ba'i gdan la tām̐ yig sogs nas/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song*/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar zhugs pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sku dang sngags phreng las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la bzlas pa ci nus mthar mchod bstod dang yi ge brgya pa brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul bas bum pa'i lha mo 'od du zhu ba'i chu nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ gtor ma gzhung ltar dbul/ rjes gnang gi lo rgyus skabs/ thog mar thams cad kyi gzhi'am rtsa ba lta bur gyur pa sgrol ma spyi sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba yin zhes sogs mtshan 'byin 'jug dang*/ mngon rtogs kyi khyad par ma 'khrul bar sbyar/ ye shes pa bstims rjes/

slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha dang slob dpon lhan cig pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis sogs nas shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob sogs sbrel/ bzlas lung gi rjes/ dam bca' ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma 'di nyid ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du yi dam du gzung ngo bdag thugs kyi ma gtong zhig snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas 'di'i gsang sngags nyi ma re re bzhin 'di tsam re 'don par dam bca' lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod/ des rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob sogs sbrel lo// gzhan yang yig rnying dang sgrub thabs rin 'byung sogs las dkar mo zla mdangs/ gser mdog can/ hūm̐ sgra sgrog ma/ bkra shis snang ba/ khro gnyer g.yo ba'i sgrol ma rnams zhabs kyi bzhugs stangs dmigs bsal med pas rdo rje'i skyil krung du mdzad/ rin 'byung las dgu pa mchog stsol sgrol ma'i 'phros don du seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso rkyang rmor chen gyi sgrub thabs dkyus las 'byung ba ltar dang*/ gtso 'khor gsum ma gnyis bkod snang na'ang*/ gtso 'khor gsum ma'i rjes gnang skabs 'dir na yam du bkod pa tsam yin pas rjes gnang dngos su mi dgos/

des na rmor chen gyi sgrub thabs dkyus ltar seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang dang*/ 'dir bshad pa ltar sgrol ma spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang*/ rmor chen pa'i yig cha ltar las tshogs so so'i rjes gnang nyer gcig bcas rjes gnang nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rgyun so sor bzhugs pa yin pas phyag len ma nyams par bya/ de'ang las tshogs so so'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs rje btsun grags pa'i yig char mig sogs yan lag drug byin rlabs dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams dgos par gsungs pa ni las kyi lha mo so so'i bsnyen pa byed pa'i skabs la dgongs shing*/ rin 'byung du de ltar mi dgos par gsungs pa ni rjes gnang tsam gyi skabs zor yang ba'i dbang du mdzad pa yin/ bum dbang yang spyi sgrub ma gtogs gzhan la mi dgos par gsungs so// //gnyis pa bsnyen pa ni/ de lta bu'i rjes su gnang bas rgyud smin cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas 'di'i bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul la gnyis/ spyi dang*/ so so'i bsnyen pa'o// dang po ni/ gnas dben par 'di nyid kyi bris sku yod na bkram pa'i spyan sngar mchod gtor bsham/ mtshams dam du bcad la thun bzhi'i rim par sgrol ma spyi sgrub kyi mngon par rtogs pa bsgoms nas/ sngags yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag bcu gsum bzla bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas las kyi lha mo nyi shu rtsa gcig po so so'i sgrub thabs ji skad bshad pa bzhin bsgoms la bzlas pa rab khri phrag bzhi/ 'bring khri/ tha ma'ang stong phrag bzhi re bzlas pas las bsgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// gsum pa las tshogs ni/ sgrol ma spyi sgrub dang 'brel ba'i las tshogs srung ba/ zhi ba/ dbang*/ rgyas pa/ shes rab sogs spel ba rnams rje btsun rin po che'i yi ge las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin nyams su blang bar bya zhing*/ de'ang sgom pa dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/

bris pa'i 'khor lo'i sgo nas las la sbyar ba'i tshul lha dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ yi ge'i kha dog so sor bsgyur ba sogs khyad par drug gi sgo nas ma 'dres par rtogs par bya'o// bye brag gi las tshogs ni/ rje btsun rin po ches/ phyir zlog yams zhi tshe 'phel gsad pa dang*// dbang byed sgrib sbyong 'pho ba rdzogs rim dang*// rab gnas dbang bskur nor spel sbyin sreg dang*// 'byung po bzlog dang 'khrul 'khor khrus chog dang*// blo 'phel chom rkun bcings dang klu nad gso// khri mun las thar mi snang mkha' spyod do// spyir 'gro'i yan lag rnam pa lnga yin te// gtor ma chu sbyin sātstsha dus gsum brtag /bu chung gzhon nu bskyed bsrung dang bcas te// las kyi rnam grangs nyi shu rtsa drug yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar sgrol ma so so'i sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i las tshogs nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*/ thun mong du dgos pa'i yan lag lnga ste nyi shu rtsa drug las/ so so'i las tshogs rnams la'ang bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyar ba'i tshul rgya gzhung dang*/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i gsal byed sa bcad dang bcas pa rnams zhib mor sbyar nas rgya cher shes par bya ba nyid do// grub chen nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs// 'phags ma'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs bcas// gsal byed skal bzang nyer mkho ba'i// tshul 'dis gzhan la sman gyur cig /ces gzhung snga ma dag las nyer mkho'i tshul mdo tsam btus pa 'di'ang 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /grub chen nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma spyi sgrub kyi mngon rtogs rnal 'byor nyer mkho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// rje btsun 'phags mar gus btud nas// nyi ma sbas pa'i man ngag bzhin// sgrub thabs rnal 'byor nyer mkho bri// 'di la gsum/

sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis/ rgyud sbyang ba dang*/ tshogs bsag pa'o// dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa'i rje btsun ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor mngon sum bzhin du dmigs la 'dun pa rtse gcig pas skyabs sems rgyas bsdus gang rung spyi ltar bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa'o// dang po ni/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun ma sgrol mar gsal ba'i snying gar padma dang zla ba'i steng du tām̐ ljang gu/ de las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su bla ma dang rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥs tshogs zhing spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥzhes pas bla ma dang*/ na maḥ.āryā tā rā sa pa re wa re bhyaḥs sgrol ma 'khor bcas la phyag bya/ snying ga'i 'od zer las me tog sogs mchod pa'i tshogs nam mkha' gang bar spros te oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs kyis bdun rnam dag bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs brjod pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad stong par bsams la blo gzhag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ lha bsgom pa dang*/ sngags bzla ba'o// dang po la bzhi las/ dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag ni/ de nas byang chub kyi sems rjes su dran pa'i stobs kyis gzugs kyi skur langs la sems can gyi don bya'o bsams pas mtshams sbyar te/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ ljang gu las utpal tām̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus nas thim pa'i skad cig la bdag nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang sngon/

phyag g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa ster ba'i skyabs sbyin/ g.yon pas utpal bzung ba'i 'dab mas rna bar reg pa/ skra cung zad li ba g.yas su cung zad 'phyang ba/ dar gyi na bzas bklubs shing rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ lang tsho dar la babs pa/ rab tu 'dzum pa'i skur gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa yan lag drug dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag ni/ de'i mig tu oṃ tā re swā hā dkar po/ rna bar oṃ tuttā re swā hā sngon po/ sna la oṃ tu re swā hā ser po/ lce la oṃ tu swā hā dmar po/ snying gar oṃ re swā hā sngon po/ spyi bor oṃ tā re ṇi swā hā ljang gu ste/ de thams cad kyang zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ dbus su padma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ ljang gu/ gsum pa ye shes pa gzhug pa sgrub pa'i yan lag ni/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs po ta la nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems ma oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ bzhi pa dbang bskur zhing rgyas 'debs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ni/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ lha'i sku snang stong sgyu ma lta bu la sems yun ring du gzung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ bsgoms pas dub na thugs rgyud bskul ba'i phyir bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor ni/

rang gi snying gar tām̐ yig la yi ge bcu pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba la sems gtad/ gsal snang skyes pa na/ de las sku dang sngags phreng 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par du rje btsun ma sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus te snying ga'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ zhes yi ge bcu pa'i sngags ci nus su bzla'o// gsum pa ni/ thun de las ldang ba na/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas sogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug thun mtshams su gtor ma gtang bar 'dod na/ ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma dang nang mchod bcas bshams la a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis dbul/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis sogs bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/

ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod gsol dang*/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ zhar byung 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gtang bar 'dod na/ gser la sogs pa'i snod gas chag med pa mdzes pa'i nang du/ 'o ma/ mar/ sran chen/ me tog 'bras yos/ dri zhim zhing srog chags med pa'i chu/ khur ba/ sha btsos/ chang la sogs pa blugs te/ ma 'byor na ni zan dang chu gtsang la sogs pa ci tsam 'byor ba la bya'o// de nas bdag nyid sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas snod rgya che ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang ba/ bcud bdud rtsi'i ngo bos gang bar bsams la/ oṃ a kā ro'i sngags lan gsum brjod cing se gol gsum gtogs pas phyogs skyong bcus gtso byas pa'i rigs drug thams cad tshim par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyis phrin las gzhol/ gtor ma dben pa'i gnas su gtang bar bya'o// de lta bu'i rim pas thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la bslab cing*/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu gsum bzlas pas las tshogs rab 'byams bsgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// klu sgrub nyi ma sbas pa yi// man ngag 'phags ma sgrub pa'i thabs// rnal 'byor nyer mkho'i zil dngar gyis// mchog thun bcud len 'grub gyur cig/ //ces pa'ang rje btsun rdo rje 'chang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab la gsal byed cung zad dang bcas 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa sarba dā su shrī yo bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
